note: Each .lolo-derived case is the lowered program of a small fixture (the files rui-g-*.lolo in the batch scratch dir) whose expected findings were taken from `orb validate --json` (the Rust check) and equal what `orb lint rui-binding` reports. The patterns step feeds the registry subset (real prop kinds and names). The listens, trigger, empty-event-set, no-pattern, list-pattern and underscore-head cases are written from render_ui/binding.rs. ORB_RUI_BINDING_TYPE_MISMATCH is not ported: it needs the compiler's binding type resolver on arbitrary expressions.

findings.message: Prop 'action' on 'button' references event 'GONE' but the trait's event set has no such key — literal is stale (likely missed by an `events: { OLD: NEW }` override rewrite, or an authoring rename that didn't reach this call site)
findings.suggestion: Either add 'GONE' to the trait's `emits` / `listens` / transition events, or rewrite the literal to match an existing event key
